title: Repair the seen notebook
hints: The walk looks in `seen` before it goes inside a box. Does anything ever get written into `seen`?
A box has to go into the notebook the first time the walk goes inside it, before the walk moves on to its sources.
Add one line before the `List.fold_left`: `seen := n :: !seen;`.

answer.explain: The walk checked the notebook but never wrote in it, so every check said "new" and the shared boxes were walked once per arrow: 15 times for `chain 3`. Putting `n` into `seen` the first time a box is entered makes every later arrival stop at the check, so each box is entered once. `List.memq` compares with `==`, so two separate boxes that look alike still count as two.
